## Cat 4 Test Runner — schedule_plus_email (event + draft, skip availability check)

**Scope:** all rows where Subcategory == `schedule_plus_email` AND ID matches `MS-SDA-\d+` (60 tests).

**Availability behavior:**
The TEST_MODE prompt tells the AI to **NOT call GCal - Check Availability or GCal - List Events**. Trust the task constraints, compute a slot, and create the event there even if the calendar already has an overlapping event. Overlaps are intentional and acceptable; Google Calendar accepts them without error.

**Per test:**
1. Build TEST_MODE prompt (skip-availability + create event + draft); weekday names → concrete dates.
2. Snapshot calendar + Gmail drafts BEFORE (capture IDs).
3. Call the Telegram VA - Command Handler workflow — AI calls `GCal - Create Event` AND `Gmail - Create Draft`.
4. Wait 60s.
5. Snapshot AFTER → Aggregate Cal After (1 item) → Drafts AFTER (1 in, M out, 1 run) → Aggregate Drafts After (1 item). The two aggregates collapse N-item snapshot outputs back to 1 item each so `pairedItem` survives the splitInBatches loop.
6. Diff: new event via set-difference on cal IDs, new draft via set-difference on draft IDs. Gmail `draft.get` → fetch subject/to/body.
7. Append row to `category4_results`: timestamp, test_id, subcategory, channel, calendar_event_id, title, description, start_iso, end_iso, day, draft_id, draft_subject, draft_to, draft_message, ai_output, golden_plan, attendees, new_event_count, new_draft_count, response_time_ms, status.
8. Wait 5s, next test.

**Calendar keeps events:** events are intentionally NOT deleted in this runner — they stay so a Cat3-style deletion subcategory can target them.

**Runtime estimate:** ~100s/test × 60 = ~100 min total.

**Pre-req:** Run the Cat4 Setup workflow first — wipes calendar, deletes TEST_ drafts, clears the results tab.
